reviews.title: Darling of reviewers, with a few small caveats
reviews.comment: There's not much else positive that can be said about this affordable workhorse. I appreciate the classic looks and color scheme, as I specifically purchased this to get away from the psychedelic disco ball seizure inducing effect of the RGBs on my previous mechanical keyboard. It's well built, has reliable actuation and works flawlessly with Bluetooth or wired. I appreciate that the USB-C port is on the left side, the muted thwack sound (but not the mushy rebound) and the battery life is excellent using Bluetooth. I recommend using a 5v wallwart charger initially, otherwise it takes forever to bring it to 100%. Complaints Configured for boutique OS usage out of the box, and you have to swap out keys to use for Windows. Apple is only a tiny segment of the desktop market, and I'm glad it will work on multiple OS', the 75%-90% of users shouldn't have to unbox and then pull keys and flip switches to utilize their keyboard. There is a rubberized coating on the key caps that doesn't seem like it will hold up long term and the keyboard always looks like you've been snacking on corn chips because normal skin oils leave smudges. There is an annoying input lag when the keyboard comes out of sleep. Despite disabling power management in the device manager, the LEDs time out and the first few keystrokes do not register, which makes for an annoying experience when you attempt to login when the machine is locked.
reviews.author: Consume!!!

reviews.title: Consistent multiple inputs across multiple Keychron keyboards
reviews.comment: I've gotten two of these keyboards, refunded one of them and now I'm stuck with another for the same issue. Both keyboards had the "s" key (and some others) double, triple, or even quintuple inputting CONSISTENTLY. I've had to backspace and correct this review because it would double input EVERY "S". Very unreliable keyboard and not worth your money.
reviews.author: Lindle
